headline: Argentina's ARCA to Suspend SME Tax Seizures and Extend Payment Plans
summary: Economy Minister Luis Caputo announced that the ARCA tax agency will suspend tax seizures for SMEs and extend payment plans for tax debts, adding that export growth could support dollarization.
why: Tax administration reforms and debt regularization measures impact cash flow and survival conditions for small and medium-sized enterprises in Argentina.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Suspending SME tax seizures eases financial pressure on domestic businesses.
